data.scope: diagnostic sampled native OS counters only, never exact scheduler events or benchmark evidence
data.initial_coverage: first successful snapshot; startup before it is not event-traced
data.timing_clock: perf_counter_ns; legacy monotonic_ns is distinct and must not be joined to QPC
data.flush_policy: flush each JSON line; no fsync/power-loss guarantee

data.scheduler: per-thread cumulative schedstat and context-switch samples; not event trace
data.schedstat_zero_policy: raw zero is not evidence of no wait; require supported/enabled counters
data.io_scope: logical/syscall and accounted storage counters if supported, not file latency
